category: Liquid Dispenser (e.g., Soap or Lotion Dispenser)

parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the internal pump and nozzle. It is made of plastic and includes the outlet spout.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outlet spout, ensuring smooth flow during dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of wood with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (soap, lotion, etc.) and supports the pump assembly on top.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the stable foundation of the dispenser.
